dialogues.speaker: Rosenthal
dialogues.text: Yes. My husband, Anselm, he's currently away. He followed Grand Master Varka on the expedition.

dialogues.speaker: Rosenthal
dialogues.text: He mentioned in his letters that he's been promoted to deputy after Cardinal Seamus was transferred...

dialogues.speaker: Rosenthal
dialogues.text: I should be proud, but when I think about Nod-Krai, with all the disasters there, my heart just won't settle... He's only in charge of logistics. If something happens, if monsters appear... how is he meant to protect himself?
